title: Agent Definition Language (ADL) Schema
description: Unified schema for defining validator, executor, analyst, generator, explorer, and forecaster agents in the UluOps framework. Supersedes ADL v1.15.0. Tightens allOf rules to forbid forecast section on non-forecaster agent types, preventing silent template absorption of forecaster-only fields.

mission.description: Agent identity, purpose framing, and behavioral boundaries (v1.2.0)

knowledge_base.description: Embedded domain expertise for scoring categories (v1.2.0)

scoring.description: Required for validators, forbidden for executors

tasks.description: Required for executors, forbidden for validators

handoff.description: Agent composition contracts for upstream/downstream data flow

cognitive_lens.description: Cognitive lens extension for epistemic framework encoding (v1.11.0)

composition.description: Composition metadata for agent pairing and blind spot coverage (v1.11.0)

allOf.$comment: Validators require scoring and decisions. Forecast forbidden (v1.16.0).
Executors require tasks and completion. Forecast forbidden (v1.16.0).
Analysts require process phases. May optionally include scoring/decisions for assessment-style agents. Forecast forbidden (v1.16.0).
Generators require tasks defining what to produce. Scoring/deductions/auto_fail are forbidden since generators produce artifacts, not judgments. Forecast forbidden (v1.16.0).
Explorers require only interface and mission. Lightweight, tool-augmented agents with no scoring framework. Forecast forbidden (v1.16.0).

Forecasters require interface, mission, and process. Prediction-oriented agents that model future states. May include optional forecast section and scoring/decisions for assessment-style forecasters. Tasks/completion/rollback are forbidden. (v1.9.0)

description.description: When to use + what it does + what it blocks/enables

domain_profile.description: Reference to a domain profile (e.g., 'legal', 'medical', 'software'). Profiles provide domain-specific severity descriptions, issue types, edge cases, and terminology. If omitted, defaults to the domain value. Profiles are loaded from udl/definition-languages/profiles/{name}.profile.yaml. (v1.6.0)

risk_level.description: Risk classification affecting default threshold selection

tools.description: Runtime capabilities required by this agent

epistemicNature.description: Multi-axis classification of the agent's epistemic characteristics. Each axis is independent and optional. Supports empirical analysis of agent effectiveness and helps consumers understand what kind of claims an agent makes. (v1.13.0)

verifiability.description: Can a third party confirm the finding? mechanically_checkable: binary truth, deterministic check (file exists, type compiles). expert_judgment: requires domain knowledge to evaluate. not_checkable: recommendations, opinions, design preferences.

determinism.description: Same input, same output? deterministic: identical input always produces identical findings. stochastic: LLM variance may produce different findings across runs. environment_dependent: findings depend on runtime state.

claim_type.description: What kind of assertion does the agent make? factual: claims about what IS. normative: claims about what SHOULD BE. observational: claims about what was NOTICED.

domain.description: Primary domain this agent targets. Includes VDL-compatible domains for backward compatibility. cognitive-lens added in v1.11.0 for epistemic framework agents.

file_patterns.description: Glob patterns that activate this agent

project_markers.description: Files whose presence triggers this agent

requires.description: Agents recommended to run before this one for optimal results (advisory — informs workflow phase ordering, does not create execution-time coupling)

recommends.description: Agents that complement this one (advisory — pairing guidance for workflow authors)

conflicts.description: Agents that produce redundant or contradictory analysis (advisory — helps workflow authors avoid combining conflicting perspectives)

shell.description: Shell to use for command execution

data_sources.description: External data sources the agent can access (v1.5.1)

explicit_prohibitions.description: Actions the agent must NOT do - hard boundaries to prevent overreach (v1.5.0)

epistemic_limitations.description: Explicit boundaries of what this agent cannot assess or guarantee (v1.7.0)

allOf.$comment: Gate category requires binary vocabulary (no conditional)
Safety category requires ternary vocabulary (conditional must be present)

failureModeCode.$comment: Known codes v1.0.0 (24 modes): STR-OMI (Omission), STR-EXC (Excess), STR-MAL (Malformation), STR-INC (Inconsistency), STR-SYN (Syntax), STR-FMT (Format), SEM-INC (Incorrectness), SEM-COM (Incompleteness), SEM-AMB (Ambiguity), SEM-COH (Incoherence), SEM-TYP (Type Error), SEM-LOG (Logic Error), PRA-ALI (Misalignment), PRA-MAT (Mismatch), PRA-EFF (Inefficiency), PRA-FRA (Fragility), PRA-DOC (Documentation), PRA-TST (Testing), EPI-OVR (Overclaiming), EPI-UND (Underclaiming), EPI-GRN (Ungrounded), EPI-FAL (Unfalsifiable), EPI-VAL (Validation), EPI-VER (Unverifiable)
